_about: The monster's effect set from the Wii U disc (its own archive). `files`: game path -> the file, byte for byte (big-endian; efl version 0x30120306). `resources`: texture -> lossless webp, model -> glb. `motions`: per motion list, motion index -> [frames, loopFrame] from the .lmt the viewer's poses were built from (lmt_fix.motions), so a clip time maps back to the motion frame the game counts (Motion[N]_loop starts at loopFrame when loopFrame > 0). Triggers come from 3U's own class code and .esq (notes/effects-em001.md).
